name: Ultimate Sticky Notes
author: Broadway Infotech

sections.description:
This plugin offers a convenient and customizable way to jot down ideas, reminders, or tasks, seamlessly integrating into your admin dashboard.

Major features in Sticky Notes include:

  • The plugin’s user-friendly interface seamlessly integrates into your admin dashboard, making it easy to create, organize, and manage your notes.
  • Move, resize, and stick your notes anywhere on the screen. They’ll stay put until you move or minimize them using the sticky note button.
  • Users can often customize the appearance of their notes, including color, size, font, and background.
  • Seamless integration with your admin dashboard for direct note access.
sections.installation: Upload the Sticky Notes to your site, activate the Sticky Notes plugin on your site and click the sticky button in the bottom right corner. Start using sticky notes immediately!

short_description: The Ultimate Sticky Notes plugin offers the create, organize, and customize notes on your admin panel.
